sources.quote:
Model Studio will update the Qwen-VL-OCR models on November 21, 2025:

  * qwen-vl-ocr will release a new snapshot: qwen-vl-ocr-2025-11-20. Its billable items change to input_token and output_token.
  * qwen-vl-ocr-latest will be updated to qwen-vl-ocr-2025-11-20, with the same pricing:
sources.supports: Provider notice dates the OCR model update to November 21, 2025, and says the stable/latest model moves to the new snapshot. The page specifies 00:00 UTC+08 as affected time.
Provider's archived pricing page shows the older OCR snapshots at approximately $0.72 input and output per million tokens.
Provider's pricing page gives the newer international Qwen-VL-OCR price as $0.07 input and $0.16 output per million tokens.

notes: Alibaba's update notice states the affected time as 2025-11-21 00:00:00 (UTC+08), depending on actual release time, so that precision is retained. The older dated snapshots remain listed at $0.717/$0.717 on the archived provider price page; the new snapshot/current International price is $0.07/$0.16.
